title: The 10 Best Cordless Immersion Blenders of 2026
h1: The 10 Best Cordless Immersion Blenders of 2026
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for cordless immersion blenders of 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at cordless immersion blenders of 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: KitchenAid Cordless Variable Speed Hand Blender KHBBV83
products.blurb: Key specs: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery, 20+ minutes of run time per charge, Variable speed control via twist dial on the base, Includes whisk and chopper attachments plus a blending jar.
strengths: 20+ minutes of continuous blending per charge covers a full week of typical soup and sauce sessions
Variable speed dial gives more control than the single-button cordless competitors
Whisk and chopper attachments included, matching corded KitchenAid kits at this price
Stainless shaft and blade guard are dishwasher-safe, unlike several rivals that require hand washing
KitchenAid build quality carries over from the corded lineup, no wobble at the shaft connection
limitations: Battery is not user-replaceable, capacity fade after 2+ years means eventual full-unit replacement
Charging cradle takes up counter or drawer space that a corded model doesn't require
features: Rechargeable lithium-ion battery, 20+ minutes of run time per charge
Variable speed control via twist dial on the base
Includes whisk and chopper attachments plus a blending jar
USB charging cradle with LED charge indicator

products.name: KitchenAid Cordless Variable Speed Hand Blender KHBBV53
products.blurb: Key specs: Rechargeable battery rated for approximately 15 minutes of continuous use, Variable speed control, Contoured soft-grip handle.
strengths: Contoured handle reduces hand fatigue noticeably during extended blending sessions
Variable speed control matches the flagship KHBBV83 at a lower price
Lighter overall weight than the KHBBV83 makes one-handed use over a pot more comfortable
KitchenAid stainless shaft quality without the top-tier price
limitations: No whisk or chopper attachments included, unlike the step-up KHBBV83
15-minute run time is shorter than the flagship model, requiring more frequent charging for heavy users
Battery capacity is not user-replaceable
features: Rechargeable battery rated for approximately 15 minutes of continuous use

products.name: OVENTE Cordless Immersion Hand Blender HR995B
products.blurb: Key specs: Rechargeable battery, roughly 15-20 uses per full charge, Single-speed operation with on/off trigger, Stainless steel blending shaft.
strengths: Best-selling cordless immersion blender in the category by rating count, reflecting broad real-world reliability
Handles standard soups and sauces without complaint despite the low price
USB-C charging means no proprietary cable to lose
limitations: Single speed only, no low setting for delicate finishing tasks
Battery capacity is noticeably shorter than the KitchenAid models, needing recharge after a few days of daily use
Plastic body feels less durable than the KitchenAid or Cuisinart competitors
features: Rechargeable battery, roughly 15-20 uses per full charge

Handles standard cooked soups and sauces reliably
limitations: Single speed only, no variable control
Fewer ratings than the HR995B, so real-world durability data is thinner
Battery is not user-replaceable
features: Rechargeable battery with roughly a week of standard use per charge
Stainless steel shaft, detachable for cleaning

Limited to the included cup size; no jar or bowl option for larger batches
USB-C charging is slower than a dedicated charging dock

Compact size makes it easy to store in a small kitchen or take on the road

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
